new_findings.title: NWI joined classification definitions conflict for repeated feature IDs
new_findings.description: Eight native wetland IDs in the bounded Osborn service capture have identical core attributes and geometry but conflicting joined wetland-code definitions. ID-only results repeat those identifiers; distinct IDs match the count. Joined interpretations remain held.

new_findings.title: NWI national availability polygon fails strict native-ring decoding
new_findings.description: The mapping-status feature intersecting Osborn (OBJECTID 3, Digital) contains a self-intersecting native ring. Its geometry is preserved and excluded from coverage overlays; valid source-imagery footprints independently cover the bounded study area.

scope.impact: Availability overlay; wetland inventory geometries separately validated

reviews.note: All variants retained. Only identical Wetlands.* core attributes and geometry are grouped for the bounded profile; joined interpretations are not selected or corrected.
reviews.next_action: Compare the eight feature codes and conflicting lookup rows with the official classification reference and Maine package. Propose a versioned interpretation only if corroborated.

reviews.note: Strict decoder finds a self-intersecting ring. No repair, correction acceptance or availability-area claim. Four valid source-imagery footprints cover the study scope, with old-image and mapping-omission caveats.
reviews.next_action: Investigate native ring structure and alternative official availability evidence before using this status polygon for coverage overlays. Preserve originals and separate source footprint coverage from real wetland completeness.
